declarations.name: AuiDashboardWidget
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI Dashboard Widget; the projected content is the body:
`<aui-dashboard-widget title="Revenue" [removable]="true" (removed)="remove(id)">...</aui-dashboard-widget>`.
The header is inserted before the Angular-managed body. `[(collapsed)]` is two-way.

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: Heading text; names the region and the action buttons. Non-empty.

inputs.name: headingLevel
inputs.description: Heading element level; changing it with update() throws.

inputs.name: subtitle
inputs.description: Supporting text under the heading (hidden when empty).

inputs.name: actions
inputs.description: Extra header icon buttons { id, label, icon } (unique ids, non-empty labels); activation emits aui-action.

inputs.name: removable
inputs.description: Show a remove button that emits the cancelable aui-remove.

inputs.name: busy
inputs.description: Set aria-busy=true on the host while content loads.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Locale of the action button names.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: Resolved with the other options; the layout itself follows the document direction (logical CSS).

models.name: collapsed
models.description: Initial and controlled collapsed state (update() sets it without an event).

outputs.name: toggled
outputs.description: The user activated the collapse/expand button.

outputs.name: maximized
outputs.description: The widget was maximized or restored (button, Escape, or setMaximized).

outputs.name: action
outputs.description: The user activated a custom header action.

outputs.name: removed
outputs.description: The user activated the remove button; id is the host's data-aui-item (its Dashboard Grid item) or null. The widget takes no default action: remove the element or call grid.removeItem(id).

methods.name: setMaximized
methods.description: Maximize the widget into a modal view, or restore it (emits `maximized`).

accessibility.pattern: Labelled region with a heading and header buttons; collapse follows the WAI-ARIA APG Disclosure pattern; maximize follows the APG modal Dialog pattern (top layer through the Popover API).

limitations: Maximize relies on the Popover API for the top layer; without HTMLElement.showPopover the widget is only fixed-positioned (it may sit under other stacked content).
The collapse button has no aria-controls: the body is every host child except the header.
headingLevel cannot change after create (recreate the widget).
The remove event has no default action: the widget stays until the application removes it.
Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
